result.topic_en: Notes on the thermodynamics and kinetic theory of gases: specific heat of air, the gas law pv = R(a+t), isothermal work, kinetic energy of molecules (3/2 pv), molecular speeds of gases, and relations between specific heats K, V and the gas constant.

methods.what: Ideal gas law with absolute temperature a+t
Isothermal work of an ideal gas
Kinetic theory: pressure-volume equals 2/3 of translational kinetic energy, giving mean square speed
Molecular speed formula for gases depending on temperature and density, with values for air, oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen
Specific volume of air as function of density and temperature
Internal heat energy from specific heat at constant volume
Mayer relation between specific heats and gas constant
Ratio of translational kinetic energy to total heat content
